title: G7 complete preflight accepted a protocol version inconsistent with the strict retry contract
evidence: Before repair, a valid complete G7 fixture with every protocol_version changed from g7-public-case-format-retry-v1 to legacy returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true with errors=[] under require_complete_plan=True.
remediation: Require exact protocol_version=g7-public-case-format-retry-v1 for every complete-plan row, add an adversarial wrong-version test, and independently verify the immutable formal plan.
